strategy.name: qqq_dual_raw_stochrsi_cross_robust_train_oos
strategy.description: Select the 14–50 by 70–160 period pair using only 2005–2020 and the frozen multidimensional robustness method, then evaluate the frozen pair once on the untouched continuous 2021–2026 account.
strategy.buy_rule: While flat, both completed prior StochRSI values are below 0.20 and both provisional same-session values cross to or above 0.20; buy at the larger joint solved trigger.
strategy.sell_rule: While long, both completed prior StochRSI values are above 0.80 and both provisional same-session values cross to or below 0.80; sell at the smaller joint solved trigger.
strategy.signal_time: Eligibility and exact triggers use only completed prior data. No observation dated 2021 or later may enter selection.
strategy.execution_time: Gaps beyond the trigger fill at Open; otherwise only the directed Open-to-Close path may fill at the exact trigger. High and Low are ignored.
strategy.positioning: Every training window and the locked holdout are separate long-only 0%/100% QQQ accounts with 100000 dollars, fractional shares, no leverage, and no cash interest.

plain_language.summary: 只用2005至2020寻找换期限、换起点和轻微改参数后仍稳定的周期，再把它原样放进2021至2026检验。
plain_language.buy: 两个周期先同时处于低位，再一起向上越过0.20时买入QQQ。
plain_language.sell: 两个周期先同时处于高位，再一起向下跌破0.80时卖出QQQ。
plain_language.execution: 前一日收盘后冻结触发价；跳空越线按开盘价成交，否则盘中只按开盘到收盘方向检查触发价。
plain_language.position: 训练窗口和验证账户都从10万美元现金独立开始，在满仓QQQ与现金之间切换，并与同期持有比较。

benchmark: Buy & Hold QQQ independently restarted in every training window and at the 2021 holdout first Open

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged for frozen training diagnostics and untouched holdout results.

research.hypothesis: The multidimensional robustness method applied only to 2005–2020 can identify a period pair whose risk-adjusted behavior persists in untouched 2021–2026 data.
research.primary_metric: Training selection uses exactly the frozen maximin and seven-gate rule from the parent experiment; the primary holdout result is CAGR at 5 bps on the single continuous 2021-01-04 through 2026-08-04 account.
research.selection_rule: Use only 132 training windows ending by 2020-12-31. Exclude boundaries, apply all seven gates, and choose the passing center with highest maximin score. If none passes, freeze the strongest near-miss and label it as such before opening the holdout.
research.validation_plan: After writing the 5 bps training selection artifact, run only the frozen selected pair and 42/100 anchor on the untouched 2021–2026 account at 0/5/10 bps, with Buy & Hold and dual-ledger reconciliation.
research.promotion_criteria: A candidate may advance only if it was selected without 2021+ data and its 5 bps holdout CAGR is positive with no ledger or engineering failure; relative performance versus Buy & Hold must be reported rather than required post hoc.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject promotion for any 2021+ selection leakage, cost fragility, nonpositive holdout CAGR, ledger mismatch, or validation failure.
